items.t: Water in the trunk or taillights
items.note: High end is a new taillight if the lens has moisture inside. Water damage to wiring costs more.

items.t: Musty or sour smell from the A/C

items.note: Some cars have two cabin filters. Use the A/C drying setting to help keep the smell away.
